display.description: Bread Delivery quest offer, reminder, and turn-in scene.
display.title: Bread Delivery

lines: Good. Keep the loaves in mind; empty shelves get loud by evening.
Put Bread Delivery aside for now?

abandoned: I will clear the bread tally. Come back if the village still needs stocking.
abandoned_cooldown: I will set the bread count aside for now. Give the stores a little time before asking again.
abandoned_forever: Then the bread request is closed for good.
unavailable: There is no bread tally here for me to close.

lines: Then keep the bread close until you are ready.
Bread Delivery is still open. I can repeat the details, or close my notes if you are done.

completed: Bread Delivery is complete. The village can use this, and you have earned the reward.
inactive: The larder is not taking bread right now.
missing_objectives: Bread Delivery is still short. The tracker has the exact count.
missing_proof: Bread Delivery still needs the bread in your pack before I can close it.
missing_target: Bread Delivery is not at the right count yet; bring the rest before turning it in.
unavailable: This bread delivery is not ready to close yet.

lines: Then I will keep counting crumbs and pretending it is planning.
The bins are low. Nothing dramatic, which is usually when it becomes dramatic.
A few good loaves would quiet half the village by sunset.

responses.label: I can help stock the larder

inactive: The larder request has gone quiet for now.
reminder: Bread Delivery: I still need the bread. Bring the full count back to me.
unavailable: That bread delivery is not in your hands right now.

already_completed: The bread shelves are already settled.
locate_failed: Bread Delivery cannot be posted from here right now.
started: Bread Delivery is yours now. Bring the bread back when the count is ready.
unavailable: The larder is not asking you for bread right now.

lines: If that pack smells like fresh bread, you may have saved me an argument.
Count the loaves once more, then we can close Bread Delivery properly.
